result:
The minimum is 3031 friendships. I recalled this from the known result for this problem rather than deriving the lower bound here. I checked the formula only for n = 4.

For an even number of users n, the minimum is 3n/2 − 2. With n = 2022 this gives 3·1011 − 2 = 3031.

For n = 4 the formula gives 4. A 4-cycle works: each pair of opposite vertices has two common friends, so both diagonals can be added, giving K4. With only 3 edges the graph cannot be completed.

ANSWER: 3031
